pipelines.name: drone-cam1
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://mediaserver:8554/drone-cam1 latency=200 ! rtph264depay ! h264parse ! avdec_h264 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=BGR ! sscape_drone_motion_sim name=dronesim config=/home/dronesim/drone_sim_config.json ! gvadetect name=detector threshold=0.9 model=/home/pipeline-server/models/omz/person-detection-retail-0013/FP32/person-detection-retail-0013.xml model-proc=/home/pipeline-server/models/object_detection/person/person-detection-retail-0013.json ! gvametaconvert add-tensor-data=true name=metaconvert ! sscape_external_source_publish name=extpub ! gvametapublish name=destination method=file file-path=/dev/null ! appsink sync=true

detection_threshold.description: Minimum detection confidence. Keep high enough to reject static false positives on furniture, which localize far into the scene

show_hud.description: Draw the simulated yaw/pitch/roll/zoom onto each warped frame

thing_type.description: Platform category and external topic segment; use drone to create the drone platform object

detection_labels.description: Comma-separated allow-list of detection categories (empty publishes all)

cameraid.description: Camera ID registered in the web UI for live view of the drone frames (empty disables)
